Message:
[SCSI] qla4xxx: overflow in qla4xxx_set_chap_entry()

We should cap the size of memcpy() because it comes from the network
and can't be trusted.

Fixes: 26ffd7b45fe9 ('[SCSI] qla4xxx: Add support to set CHAP entries')
